title: Truth table lift of a tester
statement: Given a nonadaptive tester with $r$ query positions, whose domain is the length-$d$ binary cube and whose outputs are signs, and a natural number $n$, define a tester with the same random seed distribution and $r$ query positions. It queries the truth-table index corresponding to each original cube query, placing each address in the truth-table part of the domain, and accepts exactly when the original tester accepts the transcript obtained by converting each answered Boolean value to its corresponding sign.
hypotheses_covered: A nonadaptive tester from the length-d binary cube to signs with r query positions
